tests.title: A newly registered item is received into stock through pre check-in, count and check-in
tests.goal: The main receiving flow end to end: a new item goes from NOT PRE CHECK IN to IN and only then counts in stock and can be checked out.
preconditions: The handheld app signed in (emulator is fine)
data: Item category: Consumable, first item type of that category with no Max set
Item description: QA receive <unique>, Number of units: 1

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web as administrator and note the item type's Stock in Report > Stock Level Report
Register the item in Registration > Item Register and print its tag in Asset Tag Printing
Look for the item in Check In / Out > Check Out and in Stock Level Report
On the handheld, pre check-in the item (scan its tag) and count it
Check the item in at a storage location (handheld check-in, or web Check In if it lists the item)
Open Item Information, Check Out and Stock Level Report again

expected.text: Before check-in the item is not offered in Check Out and the Stock does not include it
After pre check-in and count the status is NOT CHECKED IN and the item is listed under Tagged Not Checked In and Count Item
After check-in the status is IN at the chosen storage location and the item is offered in Check Out
The item type's Stock is 1 higher than in step 1
Audit Trail has entries for registration, tag printing, pre check-in, count and check-in

checks.label: Before check-in the item is not offered in Check Out and the Stock does not include it
After pre check-in and count the status is NOT CHECKED IN and the item is listed under Tagged Not Checked In and Count Item
After check-in the status is IN at the chosen storage location and the item is offered in Check Out
The item type's Stock is 1 higher than in step 1
Audit Trail has entries for registration, tag printing, pre check-in, count and check-in

notes: Item 002000025 "QA receive 789896" (Consumable / Glove), ADMIN. Registered 10:36 (NOT PRE CHECK IN), printed on printer "test" (chip 010010000000000002000025). Before check-in: not in Check Out, Glove Stock 2. Handheld (emulator Medium_Phone): pre check-in + count uploaded -> web Tagged Not Checked In and Count Item list it as NOT CHECKED IN; web Check In does not list it (only OUT items, Q-006), so check-in was done on the handheld (Airlock 1). After: Item Information IN at Airlock 1, Check Out offers it, Glove Stock 3 (In lab 1->2). Audit Trail: Item number assigned, Tag code issued, Tag printed, Handheld count item, Handheld register, Handheld check-in (handheld rows show "2 tag(s)", BUG-009). No item registration entry named as such: "Item number assigned" is the registration record.

tests.title: A For use item carried out through an exit gantry raises an unauthorized removal alert
tests.goal: An item checked out For use is OUT but not whitelisted, so passing exit gantry 1a or 3b is logged as unauthorized and raises an Unauthorized removal alert.
preconditions: An item checked out For use (HLW-016) and not on Gantry > Gantry Whitelist
Access to the HTX API Swagger page (/swagger) when no real gantry is available
data: Gantry: 3b EXIT (its IP from Gantry Setup)

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web as administrator, note the Dashboard alert count and confirm the item is not on Gantry Whitelist
Send the gantry read: carry the tag through gantry 3b, or in Swagger call POST /api/Gantry/unauthorizerfid with the gantry IP and the item's 24-digit chip code
Wait one minute and refresh the Dashboard
Move the item back with an authorized read at an inner gantry of its original room

expected.text: The Dashboard count goes up by 1 with "Unauthorized removal: <description> (Item Number <number>) passed exit gantry 3b EXIT."
Unauthorized Log lists the item with Gantry 3b EXIT, Status OUT and Location Airlock 2
The item keeps status OUT (a gantry never changes the status)

checks.label: The Dashboard count goes up by 1 with "Unauthorized removal: <description> (Item Number <number>) passed exit gantry 3b EXIT."
Unauthorized Log lists the item with Gantry 3b EXIT, Status OUT and Location Airlock 2
The item keeps status OUT (a gantry never changes the status)

notes: Item 003000025 "QA print chem 42609" OUT For use, not whitelisted (GantryWhitelist/status 400 false). POST /api/Gantry/unauthorizerfid at 3b EXIT (192.168.1.101) 10:34:56 -> Dashboard 21 -> 22 with "Unauthorized removal: QA print chem 42609 (Item Number 003000025) passed exit gantry 3b EXIT."; Unauthorized Log: 3b EXIT, OUT, Airlock 2, Admin; item stays OUT. Moved back with an authorized read at 2a (Chemistry). Alert left unacknowledged.

Untested P0s run by hand on UAT 2026-11-19 (web + handheld emulator + gantry API). Left behind: 002000025 IN Airlock 1; 003000025 OUT For use (back in Chemistry); open Unauthorized removal alert for 003000025.
